special: Voiceover recording sharing a personal life story
audit.notes: The visuals are standard evening home routine B-roll (coming home, making food, eating on couch, reading), but this format depends entirely on an original, highly personal voiceover narration. It cannot be replicated using only silent B-roll and on-screen text.
audit.summary: The creator films her evening solo routine at home with digital timestamp overlays while narrating a vulnerable, emotional voiceover about growing up in poverty and why she chooses to live alone.
